# recruitee fixtures

Real response from a public, unauthenticated endpoint (one request, User-Agent
`RumoJobSearch/0.1.0 (uso pessoal)`), captured on 2026-11-14.

- URL: https://techpartnerships.recruitee.com/api/offers/
- file(s): offers.json
- original size: 378,241 bytes
- original items: 62 offers
- kept: first 5 offers

Trimming: item objects are unmodified (re-serialised as indented UTF-8 JSON).
E-mail addresses inside the data are replaced by `removido@example.test`. No personal
data of candidates.

Company: techpartnerships (a Recruitee-hosted careers site found by web search; appears to contain some test listings). `mailbox_email` (a generated per-offer address) was replaced.
